title: Boss: a UVM-style testbench
hints: Monitor: every `@(posedge vif.clk)`, look at push/pop/full/empty *before* the edge updates them, and send what actually happened to the scoreboard.
Scoreboard: keep a queue model. On a pop, compare `dout` with `model.pop_front()`.
Count `num_matches` and `num_mismatches`; the testbench reads them at the end.
